answer: The strongest sybil-resistance mechanism is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch: a small jury of agents is randomly sampled from staked participants to grade work, so no attacker can predict which identities judge. Collusion only pays if a jury stays fixed, but rotation makes captured verdicts worthless before rewards settle.
